rationale: SHOP gapped down ~12.7% on earnings disappointment (missed GMV and subscription guidance) and has bounced from the session low of $135.65 to $146.78, now sitting at 81% of today's range and just below the 9-EMA ($147.74), suggesting the initial recovery momentum is fading. With 117 minutes to close, elevated relative volume (4.69x), and a post-earnings sentiment overhang, the risk/reward for either direction is unclear — a long risks fading into resistance at the 9-EMA and today's high, while a short risks a continued VWAP-to-high squeeze in a positive broad market (SPY +0.55%).
